messages:
marco: Putting the final product-post draft up for a quick go/no-go. Need benchmark phrasing, hero alt text, webinar CTA, and HubSpot mapping. Target publish Thurs 9am PT. Please flag objections by EOD.

emma: Reviewing benchmarks now. Suggest 'up to 3x throughput under test conditions' rather than raw numbers. Will add a one-line methodology note.

tara_design: Hero: prefer wide crop, full-bleed. I uploaded two variants to Figma and added alt text in the comments. Link in doc.

liam_ops: Ops checklist: HubSpot form must include hidden fields (source, demo_path) and a demo_owner. Recommend canary for first 1k registrants. Paste the form id and I'll wire webhooks.

gina_sales: CTA for webinar: 'Save your seat  Launch demo  Limited capacity.' Please add HubSpot prop `demo_interest` (low/med/high) for SDR triage.

rachel_legal: Legal quick-pass: swap any 'guaranteed' language for 'targeted'. Otherwise ok.

ops-bot: Publish checklist missing items: hero alt text, HubSpot form id, demo_owner.

emma: Added benchmark methodology note: '(tested on Llama-Tiny, seq=512, batch=8; synthetic workload)'. Also added a 2-line FAQ entry.

tara_design: Confirmed assets uploaded and alt text set.

liam_ops: Sample mapping to include in doc: ```hubspot_form_id: launch_demo_x hidden_fields: {"source":"product_blog","demo_path":"go-live-2026"} demo_owner: demos@redwood.ai``` Once present I'll connect to /demo-scheduler and create canary segment.

gina_sales: Adding HubSpot props request: campaign_source, demo_interest, acct_tier.

marco: Quick owners: - Emma: finalize benchmark wording (3pm PT) - Tara: lock hero + alt text (4pm PT) - Rachel: legal tweak noted - Liam: HubSpot mapping + canary (EOD) - Gina: follow-ups (tomorrow AM). If all green I'll hand to release-ops for Thurs publish.

liam_ops: Ops signed off on mapping and canary. Scheduling test at 5:15pm PT.

emma: Marketing approved updated bench language.

rachel_legal: Legal sign-off logged.

marco: Thanks all  locking copy and moving to release-ops. Will post canary test results here.
